title: Navigation: Breadcrumb path bar (clickable path segments)
acceptance_criteria: Breadcrumb bar displayed at top of file list panel
Each path segment rendered as clickable button (home > tmp > subdir)
Clicking a segment navigates directly to that directory
Current directory segment styled differently (bold or highlighted)
Breadcrumb bar scrolls horizontally if path exceeds panel width
Home button (house icon) navigates to $HOME directory
Integration test: click breadcrumb segment and verify navigation occurs
